text: The Endangered Species Reserve Fund supports conservation and education projects to benefit endangered species in Canada and around the world. The 2022 Endangered Species Reserve Fund Budget is attached for approval.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the Endangered Species Reserve Fund Projects listed in Appendix I to the report (May 24, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo with net expenditures of $150,000.
